per_question.question: What refund does a policyholder receive if they cancel Group Health Insurance before half the policy period has elapsed?
per_question.ground_truth: If the Group Health Insurance policy is cancelled by the policyholder before half the policy period has elapsed (i.e. up to 1/2 of policy period), a 25% refund of the premium is provided. If cancelled within the first quarter (up to 1/4 of the policy period), a 50% refund applies.

per_question.question: Are sexually transmitted diseases covered under Group Health Insurance?
per_question.ground_truth: No, sexually transmitted diseases are excluded under Group Health Insurance. This includes Genital Warts, Syphilis, Gonorrhoea, Genital Herpes, Chlamydia, Pubic Lice and Trichomoniasis.
per_question.answer: Treatment for sexually transmitted diseases is excluded from coverage under the Group Health Insurance policy unless otherwise specified [source 2, page 10].
